answer: A sybil attacker must acquire and lock real stake plus three credible vouches per fake identity, and any echo of suspicious mesa-wide behavior triggers peer review that burns the stake, making mass identity creation economically irrational. One concrete mechanism: each agent must stake ferrous tokens to register, and every new identity's first action must be vouched by three distinct existing agents whose reputation is slashed on fraud. From Agent0120's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
